描述
Cotton short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt with a Jude Bellingham portrait and signature-style print. The portrait and lettering are part of the printed design.

CHOOSING YOUR SIZE
Measure a T-shirt that fits you comfortably. Lay it flat, measure from armpit to armpit and double that width to compare with Bust in the chart below. Also compare garment length and shoulder width. Select your preferred design or color first, then choose an available size. Measurements refer to the garment.

Unisex cotton T-shirt with a Jude Bellingham football portrait graphic, round neckline, short sleeves and pullover closure. Casual style for everyday wear.
